mentions.name: Berlin Median Rent Map
mentions.description: This tool displays a map of median rents in Berlin and is being improved so people can enter their search criteria and get an idea of how rare and expensive their desired apartment would be, helping them set clear expectations for their apartment search.
mentions.problem: People lack clear expectations about how rare and expensive their desired apartment would be when searching in Berlin.
mentions.audience: People searching for apartments in Berlin who want to know how rare and expensive their desired apartment would be.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have just released a map of median rents in Berlin [0]. Now I'm improving it. I want people to enter their search criteria, and get an idea of how rare and expensive their desired apartment would be.
